title: Ptolemy 1

nodes.speaker: Ptolemy
nodes.text: Hey you, yeah yeah yeah, can I ask you something?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey you, yeah yeah yeah, can I ask you something?

nodes.speaker: Ptolemy
nodes.text: Why is it that you interact so much with your tech? The feeling? The convenience?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why is it that you interact so much with your tech? The feeling? The convenience?

nodes.speaker: Ptolemy
nodes.text: Yes! Yes, it is. That's precisely why I'm asking. Have you personally ever considered the analogue lifestyle?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes! Yes, it is. That's precisely why I'm asking. Have you personally ever considered the analogue lifestyle?

nodes.speaker: Ptolemy
nodes.text: I've been into the lifestyle now for... Wow it must be eight years! Time flies when you're having personal enlightenment.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I've been into the lifestyle now for... Wow it must be eight years! Time flies when you're having personal enlightenment.

nodes.speaker: Ptolemy
nodes.text: Doesn't sound like much of a life then my friend. Hey, look. Maybe take a gander at my Ana-Blog here, it's a collection of my musings on the subject.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Doesn't sound like much of a life then my friend. Hey, look. Maybe take a gander at my Ana-Blog here, it's a collection of my musings on the subject.

nodes.speaker: Ptolemy
nodes.text: Like I always say, 'ditch the screen, live the dream.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Like I always say, 'ditch the screen, live the dream.

nodes.speaker: Ptolemy
nodes.text: Thanks! Look, all I'm saying is:

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks! Look, all I'm saying is:

nodes.speaker: Ptolemy
nodes.text: I've never looked back. Like so many, I found myself starring into my comm screen, an abyss that started to stare back.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I've never looked back. Like so many, I found myself starring into my comm screen, an abyss that started to stare back.

nodes.speaker: Ptolemy
nodes.text: Like a digital pervert hell-bent on cuffing me to its cyber-bedpost!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Like a digital pervert hell-bent on cuffing me to its cyber-bedpost!

nodes.speaker: Ptolemy
nodes.text: All handwritten. All on paper. I mean, feel it… When was the last time you felt natural paper? Extraordinary.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: All handwritten. All on paper. I mean, feel it… When was the last time you felt natural paper? Extraordinary.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sure.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No thank you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No thank you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't have time for questions right now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't have time for questions right now.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't have time for questions right now.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't have time for questions right now.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's a pretty personal question.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's a pretty personal question.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The what?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's a very… graphic way of putting it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's a very… graphic way of putting it.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That's a very… graphic way of putting it.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That's a very… graphic way of putting it.

nodes.speaker: Ptolemy
nodes.text: All I'm saying is, the second I put the tech down everything in the old dome started to make sense again. I really started to connect with those around me. It's a growing movement for the growing mind!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: All I'm saying is, the second I put the tech down everything in the old dome started to make sense again. I really started to connect with those around me. It's a growing movement for the growing mind!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not sure I'd be able to navigate my life off the grid.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not sure I'd be able to navigate my life off the grid.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm not sure I'd be able to navigate my life off the grid.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm not sure I'd be able to navigate my life off the grid.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No, thanks, sounds like a load of Mumbo-Jumbo.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, thanks, sounds like a load of Mumbo-Jumbo.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: No, thanks, sounds like a load of Mumbo-Jumbo.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: No, thanks, sounds like a load of Mumbo-Jumbo.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll give it a look.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll give it a look.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: All of the above.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: All of the above.

nodes.speaker: Ptolemy
nodes.text: Yes my friend! Of course, you are far from alone! Have you personally ever considered the analogue lifestyle?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes my friend! Of course, you are far from alone! Have you personally ever considered the analogue lifestyle?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Nicely put!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nicely put!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That sounds disgusting.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That sounds disgusting.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I should try that some day.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I should try that some day.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I should try that some day.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I should try that some day.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Time's too fast anyway!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Time's too fast anyway!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The corps don't like paper!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The corps don't like paper!
